## Including Plots

The FANTASY INDEX GRAPHS

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}


mode <- "NEW_TEAM"   # אפשר "TOT" או "NEW_TEAM"

# --- ניקוי שמות + טיפול בקידוד ---
players0 <- players %>%
  mutate(
    Player = stri_trans_general(Player, "Latin-ASCII"),
    Player = gsub("[^A-Za-z ]", "", Player)
  )

if (mode == "TOT") {
  # ===== גישה 1: לשמור רק את השורה המאוחדת (TOT/2TM) אם קיימת, אחרת שורה יחידה =====
  players_one_row <- players0 %>%
    group_by(Player) %>%
    # אם קיימת שורת TOT/2TM – לקחת אותה; אחרת לקחת כל מה שיש (לרוב שורה בודדת)
    arrange(desc(Team %in% c("TOT","2TM"))) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()

} else if (mode == "NEW_TEAM") {
  # ===== גישה 2: לשמור את "הקבוצה החדשה" (השהות הקצרה יותר) =====
  # הסר שורות TOT/2TM
  players_no_tot <- players0 %>% filter(!Team %in% c("TOT","2TM"))

  # ברירת מחדל: בחר לכל שחקן את השורה עם הכי מעט משחקים (G) – בד"כ זו אחרי הטרייד
  players_one_row <- players_no_tot %>%
    group_by(Player) %>%
    slice_min(G, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  # --- Optional: Overrides ידניים אם תרצה להכריע מפורשות ---
  # דוגמה: אם תרצה לקבע ש"James Harden" = "LAC", "Damian Lillard" = "MIL"
  latest_team_map <- c(
    # "James Harden" = "LAC",
    # "Damian Lillard" = "MIL"
  )

  if (length(latest_team_map) > 0) {
    manual_rows <- players_no_tot %>%
      semi_join(
        tibble(Player = names(latest_team_map), Team = unname(latest_team_map)),
        by = c("Player","Team")
      )
    # נחליף עבור השחקנים שיש להם override
    players_one_row <- players_one_row %>%
      filter(!Player %in% names(latest_team_map)) %>%
      bind_rows(manual_rows)
  }
}

# שחקנים ששיחקו מעל 15 דק בלבד
players_clean <- players_one_row %>%
  filter(!is.na(MP), MP > 15,G>25)

# === חישובי per-36 ===
players_36 <- players_clean %>%
  mutate(
    PTS_36 = PTS * (36 / MP),
    TRB_36 = TRB * (36 / MP),
    AST_36 = AST * (36 / MP),
    STL_36 = STL * (36 / MP),
    BLK_36 = BLK * (36 / MP),
    TOV_36 = TOV * (36 / MP),
    FG3_36 = `3P` * (36 / MP),
    FGA_36 = FGA * (36 / MP),
    FG_36  = FG  * (36 / MP),
    FT_36  = FT  * (36 / MP)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    FantasyIndex = PTS_36*1 + TRB_36*1.2 + AST_36*2 + STL_36*4 + FG3_36*2 + BLK_36*4 - TOV_36*2 +
                   (`FG%` * 2) + (`FT%` * 1.5)
  )

# דוגמה: דירוג + שני גרפים (1–30, 31–60) אחרי הסרת כפילויות
ranked <- players_36 %>% arrange(desc(FantasyIndex)) %>% mutate(Rank = row_number())
top_1_30  <- ranked %>% filter(Rank <= 30)
top_31_60 <- ranked %>% filter(Rank > 30, Rank <= 60)

plot_fantasy <- function(df, title_suffix){
  ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(Player, FantasyIndex), y = FantasyIndex, fill = Pos)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.65, color = "white") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(title = paste0("NBA Fantasy Index per 36 – ", title_suffix),
       
         x = "", y = "Fantasy Score per 36", fill = "Position") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9.5, lineheight = 1.25),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

plot_fantasy(top_1_30,  "Ranks 1–30")
plot_fantasy(top_31_60, "Ranks 31–60")



```


```{r index per position}


# === חישוב ממוצע לכל עמדה ===
pos_baseline <- players_36 %>%
  group_by(Pos) %>%
  summarise(
    PosMean = mean(FantasyIndex, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# === חיבור הממוצע לעובדים עצמם ===
players_by_role <- players_36 %>%
  left_join(pos_baseline, by = "Pos")

# === בחירת טופ 10 לכל עמדה ===
top_by_role <- players_by_role %>%
  group_by(Pos) %>%
  slice_max(FantasyIndex, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# === גרף נקי עם קו ממוצע לכל עמדה ===
ggplot(top_by_role,
       aes(x = fct_reorder(Player, FantasyIndex),
           y = FantasyIndex, fill = Pos)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, color = "white") +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = PosMean),
             color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ Pos, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "NBA Fantasy Index per 36 – לפי עמדה",
    x = "", y = "Fantasy Score per 36",
    fill = "Position"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9.5, lineheight = 1.2),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
pos_summary <- players_36 %>%
  group_by(Pos) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_FantasyIndex = round(mean(FantasyIndex, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Median_FantasyIndex = round(median(FantasyIndex, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD_FantasyIndex = round(sd(FantasyIndex, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Mean_FantasyIndex))

# הצגת טבלה מסודרת
pos_summary


```

```{r DeniStats}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# 1) שורה/ות של דני מתוך players_36
deni <- players_36 %>%
  filter(str_detect(Player, regex("^Deni\\s+Avdija$", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  select(Player, Team, Pos, G, MP, FantasyIndex)


# מצרף ממוצע עמדה ומחשב פער ואחוזון בתוך העמדה
deni_ctx <- deni %>%
  left_join(pos_baseline, by = "Pos") %>%
  mutate(OverPosition = round(FantasyIndex - PosMean, 2))

# אחוזון של דני בתוך העמדה (0–100)
deni_pct <- players_36 %>%
  group_by(Pos) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * percent_rank(FantasyIndex)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(str_detect(Player, regex("^Deni\\s+Avdija$", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  select(Player, Pos, FantasyIndex, pct)

deni_ctx
deni_pct

```






Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
